enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Chilling 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 3d6 Ice damage on each hit.
Freezing 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 7 to 42 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Dragon's Edge 3: +9% Enhancement bonus to bypass enemy Fortification. On Crit: 3d8 Bleeding Damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
